blurb.text: A country with five wine regions: Galilee, the Judean Hills, Shimshon, the Negev and the Sharon plain. Cabernet Sauvignon, Carignan and Merlot are the most planted grapes. The modern industry was founded by Baron Edmond James de Rothschild, owner of Bordeaux's Château Lafite-Rothschild.
